basis: HiFi, ONT and DNBSEQ runs are named and mapped to V14167 raw BioSamples
paper reports V14167 accession material and assembly in the same study
donor_match.limitation: paper reports 20 plants and young-leaf collection per accession; a single-plant DNA extraction/library chain is not publicly proven

raw_libraries.reported_bytes_basis: ENA fastq_bytes sum; exact integer byte field not retained in source table
raw_libraries.expected_role: primary long-read repeat discovery and abundance input

pilot_plan.full_enrollment_condition: only after both pilot replicates pass all hard validation rules and resource budget review

input_validation.expected_observation_policy: reported assembly length, gap count and telomere count are source expectations; local FASTA checks may downgrade status and must not silently rewrite the accession

hard_stop: any run accession, BioSample accession, species or isolate fails exact manifest match
run is restricted, withdrawn, has zero payload, or source URL resolves to another record
platform or file format is inconsistent with the manifest
observed base count differs from reported bases by more than 10 percent without a recorded source explanation
checksum or file size changes during staging
paired-end short-read mates are incomplete or cannot be linked to the same run
assembly accession or assembly checksum does not match the frozen manifest
pilot produces fewer than two nonempty validated modality replicates
peak storage or memory exceeds the approved pilot budget by more than 20 percent
review_stop: assembly has unexpected Ns, sequence count or total length relative to the paper report
repeat signal is supported by only one modality or one pilot replicate
material metadata is V14167 at accession level but single-donor/library identity remains unresolved
DNBSEQ short-read bases are available but the source table does not expose exact integer bytes
stop_rules.interpretation_boundary: a stop or pass decision is a data-ingestion/QC decision; it is not evidence that the assembly is absolute copy-number truth
